units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 14:4:5">Y. Sabb. XIV, 14ᵈ</cite> top <he>עוּקַץ עקרב</he> Scorpion’s Tail (name of a plant); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:2:4">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40ᵈ</cite> top.
Gen. R. s. 12 והע׳ שלו למעלה the pointed stroke of the letter He is directed upwards.
Kel. XIII, 5; Sabb. 52ᵇ מחט … עוּקצָהּ a needle whose point is broken off (v. חוֹר I); a. e.—Esp. the peduncle of fruits.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 3:6">Succ. III, 6</cite> <he>נטל עוּקְצוֹ</he> if its (the Ethrog’s) peduncle is off.

Lev. R. s. 30 תמרה יש בה אוכל ויש בה ע׳ on the palm there is eatable fruit and there are prickles. Ukts. l. c. עוּקְצֵי תאנים the peduncles of figs; a. fr.—‘Uḳtsim, ‘Uktsin, name of a treatise of the Mishnah and Tosefta, of the Order of Toharoth.
<cite ref="Horayot 13b:15">Hor. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>ניתי מר וניתני בע׳</he> come, sir, lecture on ‘Uktsin.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 5:2:7">Y. Dem. V, 24ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>בתחלת כל ע׳ וע׳</he> (not <he>בתחלה</he>) at the beginning of each corner (in which fruits are piled up).
